mapping_method: Registered numbered-master label centers against the original SVG render; assigned enclosed vector elements by exact fill hit-testing; classified stripe bars and bead shapes by measured vector bounds; section 26 uses narrow gap overlays between bead rims.
notes: Original vector geometry and original outlines are preserved.
Section 26 consists of 104 narrow gap overlays between the white bead shapes so the bead rims remain untouched.
Sections 29 and 30 are assigned by original dark/light stripe-bar fills.
Supplier swatch screen colors are approximations; verify physical supplier swatches before production.
